details:
I was trying to find more potential feedback for the "problem of verticality" I believe the new profiles have. I've been designing, redesigning, and rethinking profile designs. But I've been editing them based on my local profile, as it's the most controllable.

As I was going through a few profiles to see how the UI felt with players who had different settings. (no bio, or no languages/links, notes vs no notes, etc.) I realized that every single profile felt ever so slightly better than my own, layout wise. (still not great)

That was when I noticed that the discrepancy. The local profile is the only one with a wallet and inventory button. Which isn't even necessary to use to get to the wallet nor inventory, which have their own buttons 1/10th of the screen away.

I might be willing to say it was for some sort of convenience to get to the profile when your in those menus, rather than the other way around. Except that the profile too has it's own dedicated button also 1/10th of the screen away.

So why matter? It's not like you go to your own bio to read the information there. (Despite that, "Current Avatar" is also a new field exclusive to your own local profile). Well, it's because when you design your profile, you should have a good idea and accurate control of what other users will see of your profile when they go there.

Also, redundant buttons. I don't know how many people even realize your profile and wallet are connected.
title: [1879]Remove the "Profile/Wallet/Inventory" from local profile.
